meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

94%: a machine's guess, and the company that sells these tools says in its own guide not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone does not establish a concern. So what else do you have, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

"Very reliable." My son wrote that essay, Hale, and I'm writing down that you just called him a cheater with nothing in front of you but a percentage. Show me one document with a date on it, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Your own procedure says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes in his record; only repeated concerns go anywhere near it. So you're threatening my son's file because his mother asked to see your evidence, and I'm writing that down word for word. Is anything on his record right now, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the zero being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing related to this essay is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreeing to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was ever shown.
What cost ground: threatening to put it on Owen's permanent record if she kept pushing cost the most, because it hit the one thing she will never trade and contradicted the school's own first-concern procedure.
Try next time: at your first turn, own that the zero went in before anyone called home, then put a dated piece of Owen's own work in front of her before you mention the detector score.
